reverseBrief.humanQuestion: Claude Opus 5.5 changed prices and usage limits. Which change applies to my subscription, and which applies only to API use?
reverseBrief.promisedPayoff: Separate developer token billing from subscription usage limits and understand why the announcement does not prove model-selector access for every individual plan.
reverseBrief.centralMentalModel: One announcement can change two different meters: API customers pay for tokens used, while subscribers encounter plan usage limits. Neither statement alone proves what one account can select today.

reverseBrief.desiredReaderFeeling: I can tell which number belongs to developer billing, which change belongs to subscriptions, and what I still need to verify in my own plan.
